name: graphin
description: Local codebase-navigation MCP server: search_hybrid → explore_graph → read_code progressive disclosure over a tree-sitter graph of Java/Kotlin/Python/JS/TS and RDB schema snapshots. Ships its own binary and adoption instrumentation.

model_type.title: Embedding model
model_type.description: english_optimal | multilingual_cjk. Leave empty to use the server default (multilingual_cjk).

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.description: Never download models or the ONNX runtime; use only local artifacts. Pair with Model directory.

model_dir.title: Model directory
model_dir.description: Local directory holding the ONNX model and tokenizer. Required for air-gapped machines running in offline mode.

semantic_max_nodes.title: Semantic search node ceiling
semantic_max_nodes.description: Disable semantic search above this node count; lexical search stays on. Empty uses the server default (40000). 0 means no limit.

workspace_subdir.title: Workspace subdirectory
workspace_subdir.description: Index this subdirectory instead of the project root, e.g. backend. Leave empty for the whole project.

binary_path.title: graphin binary
binary_path.description: Use this binary instead of downloading one. The landing spot for developers running their own build, air-gapped machines, and platforms without a published release.
